headline_seed: Middle East crisis live: Donald Trump cancels US envoy trip to Pakistan for ceasefire talks with Iran
description_seed: US president says ‘too much time’ has been ‘wasted on traveling’ as Israel strikes Lebanon, claiming Hezbollah also launched rockets We have some images coming through the newswires of Iran’s foreign minister, Abbas Araghchi , speaking with Pakistan’s army chief, Asim Munir, and other officials in Islamabad this morning. Araghchi arrived in Pakistan last night. He wrote on social media that his trip would focus on “bilateral matters and regional developments”. Continue reading...

what: Middle East crisis live: Donald Trump cancels US envoy trip to Pakistan for ceasefire talks with Iran

clean_source_blocks.text: US president says ‘too much time’ has been ‘wasted on traveling’ as Israel strikes Lebanon, claiming Hezbollah also launched rockets We have some images coming through the newswires of Iran’s foreign minister, Abbas Araghchi , speaking with Pakistan’s army chief, Asim Munir, and other officials in Islamabad this morning. Araghchi arrived in Pakistan last night. He wrote on social media that his trip would focus on “bilateral matters and regional developments”. Continue reading...
“I just cancelled the trip of my representatives going [to] Islamabad, Pakistan, to meet with the Iranians. Too much time wasted on traveling, too much work!” Trump wrote on Truth Social.
Araghchi made the remark on X after visiting Islamabad, Pakistan, for a meeting with Pakistan's Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif.
President Donald Trump said Saturday after canceling a U.S. delegation’s trip to Pakistan that the Iranian regime is suffering from “tremendous infighting and confusion.”
